data.title: PremiumCMS — your own CMS, your own site, pay only for what you use

content.html:
A complete website platform you can run without us worrying — or you.

PremiumCMS gives every project its own isolated CMS on Cloudflare: its own database, storage, domain and email. Pick a theme, get a blog, shop, bookings or a restaurant in minutes, and pay for usage from credits — no subscription, no surprise bills.

Create your accountSee pricing

What you get

Your own isolated site

Every project is a separate worker with its own database, media bucket and admin — nothing shared with other customers.

Themes that are real products

Blog, shop, dental practice, restaurant: each theme ships with the plugins, pages and seed content it needs. Host it here or fork it to GitHub Pages.

Plugins that work together

Commerce, Bookings, Restaurant, Forms and Site Kit share one language: learn the shop once, reuse it on a booking site.

Pay as you go

Buy credits, spend them on real usage at cost plus a published markup. When credits run out your site pauses — it never bills you.

Your domain and email

Point your domain and branded email at your site from its settings; we handle DNS, certificates and delivery.

One-click theme updates

Themes are versioned. Pull updates when you want them, keep your customisations when you fork.

How it works

Sign up
Email only — we send you a sign-in link, no password to remember.
Add credits
Pick a pack. Credits pay the small setup fee and load your new site.
Create a site
Choose a name; your worker, database, storage and domain are provisioned in about a minute.
Build
Open the admin, apply a theme, write. Add Commerce or Bookings from the marketplace when you need them.
Get started

From the blog
